alt: Side-by-side before/after comparison of photos processed by Sony Xperia AI Camera Assistant, showing the AI-enhanced right panel is noticeably washed out with reduced colour and contrast compared to the original
story: Sony launched an AI Camera Assistant for the Xperia 1 VIII that supposedly improves your photos, then posted official before/after marketing shots where the AI-processed version was visibly washed out, overexposed and lower quality; Nothing CEO Carl Pei publicly asked 'This must be engagement farming?' and Sony had to quietly post new comparisons.
why_funny: Sony ran a marketing campaign to prove their AI made photos better, accidentally proved the opposite, and had to reshoot their own proof.
